sections.strategy: George opened its standalone concept store at Parkgate Shopping, Rotherham on 1 October. It is the seventh former Asda Living site converted to the George format and the last standalone opening of 2026, following Barnsley in August. The store carries much bigger womenswear and menswear ranges and an expanded George Home offer. Asda's stated ambition is 100 standalone George stores over five years, under incoming CEO Helen Connolly (ex-New Look, appointed July 2026).
sections.pricing: Competitive pressure keeps building. Primark's 'Iconic Value' cuts (up to 29% on hundreds of lines, e.g. £9 jeans and hoodies) run through AW26. Sainsbury's Tu has launched its 'most elevated' AW26 range (cashmere from £69). Tesco relaunched a dedicated F&F website in mid-September. George is answering with a 'high-end fashion at high-street value' message rather than announcing price cuts.
sections.launches: George's AW26 marketing push is still live. The 'If You Know, You Know' womenswear campaign (Lucky Generals, styled by Sinead McKeefry; launched 22 Sept) features tweed, tartan, wool coats and faux-fur jackets. Alongside it is the Micah Richards menswear collaboration, now stocked in the new standalone stores.
sections.gossip: Correction to last week's note: Asda's January 2026 announcement was about outsourcing George online distribution to DHL Derby from January 2027 (about 1,200 jobs at risk), not buying or design. Karl Doyle is fronting store openings as George commercial director while the trade watches for Helen Connolly's start date and first strategic moves.
soWhat: The standalone rollout (7 stores now, 100 targeted) means more SKUs per store, especially womenswear, menswear and home textiles. Suppliers should pitch range-extension depth, not just core basics.
Wool-blend, tweed and tartan wovens, faux fur and structured outerwear are the AW26 hero stories. Mills and makers with these capabilities should position for AW27 development now.

A new CEO from New Look, plus price pressure from Primark, Tu and F&F, points to a possible supplier-base and cost review in 2027. Get cost-reduction and speed-to-market proposals ready before Connolly's first range reviews.
